title: triticum hordeaceum
intro: Triticum hordeaceum, commonly known as barley, is a type of cereal grain belonging to the grass family. It has been used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of barley include its potential to support digestive health, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of barley include fiber, vitamins, minerals, and a compound called beta-glucan, which has been shown to have prebiotic properties and support immune function.
